decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +1.6% and S&P 500 +1.1% point to a risk-on day, so with 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold we deployed into two of our best-scoring, most liquid momentum names rather than idling cash. We stayed at medium conviction since volume-surge confirmation wasn't present, and left existing winners untouched per prior lessons about not exiting on strength.

market_education.summary_en: Broad tech-led gains pushed the NASDAQ up 1.6% and the S&P 500 up 1.1% today, consistent with continued risk appetite across growth and momentum names. Breadth was solid, with many screened stocks showing bullish MACD crossovers and RSI readings in the healthy 55-70 range rather than extreme overbought territory. No single catalyst headline is available for today's session, so the move looks like a continuation of the broader momentum trend rather than a news-driven spike.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技股帶動大盤上揚，納斯達克指數上漲1.6%，標普500指數上漲1.1%，顯示市場風險偏好持續升溫。多隻篩選股票出現MACD黃金交叉，RSI落在55至70的健康區間，並未出現過熱超買現象，顯示上漲動能較為健康。目前沒有明確的單一新聞事件驅動今日走勢，較像是既有動能行情的延續。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on the idea that stocks moving higher on strong volume and technical signals (like MACD crossovers) tend to keep moving in that direction for a while. It works best when confirmed by multiple signals together, since any single indicator can give false signals.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入正處於上升趨勢的股票，其邏輯是當股票在強勁成交量與技術訊號（如MACD黃金交叉）配合下上漲時，往往會延續一段時間的漲勢。這種策略在多項訊號同時確認時效果最佳，因為單一指標容易出現假訊號。
